name: Reincarnated Druid
summary: Spun off into the endless circle of life, an incarnate druid is an embodiment of nature’s eternal renewal.
replacesText: Woodland Stride; Resist Nature's Lure; Venom Immunity; Timeless Body

features.name: Mysterious Stranger (Ex)
features.summary: At 2nd level, a reincarnated druids adds 1/2 her druid level to the DC of Sense Motive, Diplomacy, and Knowledge checks to learn about her. This ability replaces woodland stride.

features.name: Resist Death’s Touch (Ex)
features.summary: At 4th level, a reincarnated druid gains a +4 bonus on saving throws against death effects, energy drain, and necromancy effects, and on stabilization checks when dying. This ability replaces resist nature’s lure.

features.name: Many Lives (Ex)
features.summary: At 5th level, if a reincarnated druid is killed, she may automatically reincarnate (as the spell) 1 day later. The reincarnated druid appears in a safe location within 1 mile of her previous body. At will for the next 7 days, she can sense the presence of her remains as if using locate object as a spell-like ability. If she is killed during these 7 days, she remains dead and does not reincarnate. The many lives ability does not function ifthe reincarnated druid is slain by a death effect. A reincarnated druid cannot be raised from the dead or resurrected, though she can be reincarnated.

resourceActions.label: Record qualifying death

confirmations.label: The killing effect was not a death effect

activeEffect.name: Many Lives — awaiting reincarnation
activeEffect.description: The character returns automatically via reincarnate after 1 day in a safe location within 1 mile of the previous body. Raise dead and resurrection are unavailable.

resourceActions.summary: Start the exact one-day delay before automatic reincarnation.

resourceActions.label: Complete automatic reincarnation

activeEffect.name: Many Lives — seven-day vulnerability
activeEffect.description: For 7 days, sense the previous remains at will as locate object. If killed during this window, remain dead and do not reincarnate.

resourceActions.summary: Finish the return and begin the exact seven-day remains-sensing and no-second-reincarnation window.

values.rule: Cannot be raised or resurrected; may still be reincarnated. Death effects prevent Many Lives.

features.name: Wild Shape (Su)
features.summary: A reincarnated druid gains this ability at 6th level, and it functions at her druid level – 2.

resourceActions.label: Assume Reincarnated Druid Wild Shape

modes.label: Plant creature
modes.summary: Use plant shape at the tier allowed by effective level.

activeEffect.name: Reincarnated Druid Wild Shape
activeEffect.description: Assume the selected form using an effective Druid level 2 lower than actual level.

resourceActions.summary: Spend one use; form access, daily uses, and duration all use Druid level − 2.

features.name: Cheat Death (Ex)
features.summary: At 9th level, once per day, a reincarnated druid may reroll a save against a death effect, energy drain, or necromancy effect before the result of the roll is revealed, or reroll a failed stabilization check while dying. She must take the result of the second roll, even if it is worse than the original roll. This ability replaces venom immunity.

resourceActions.label: Cheat Death reroll

confirmations.label: Save is against death, energy drain, or necromancy before result is revealed, or is a failed stabilization check

resourceActions.summary: Spend the daily use and take the second roll even if it is worse.

features.name: Tongue of the Sun and Moon (Ex)
features.summary: At 15th level, a reincarnated druid can speak with any living creature. This ability replaces timeless body.

progressionProfiles.label: Tongue of the Sun and Moon

mechanicalNotes: Information DC scaling, every death/necromancy defense, the one-day reincarnation and separate seven-day vulnerability lifecycle, level − 2 Wild Shape, mandatory Cheat Death reroll, and universal speech are automated.
